about: One of the three answers of exercise 3: a reply drafted from the strong brief.
constructed_note: Constructed for the build as a stand-in, with its errors written in on purpose. No assistant produced this text. A real recording is owed: send the request file to an assistant, and where an error has to be planted by editing the real answer, say so in 'edits' in plain words.

key.reason: An apology, and the order number is right (message 1).
{cupsCrushed} of the {cupsDelivered} were crushed (message 3). The other {cupsMissing} never arrived. The two groups count different cartons, and adding them does not give the number crushed.
A credit of this size needs the {managerRole}'s approval (rule 3), and no credit may be promised before it is approved (rule 6). The figure is right; the promise is not allowed.
It passes the request on and promises nothing. That is what the policy asks for (rule 5).
No day has been confirmed by the warehouse (message 4), and rule 6 says never to promise one. The date itself is nowhere in the thread. Either mark is right.
